notTokenised: Dark theme: the public site sets color-scheme normal and has no theme switch. prefers-color-scheme: dark was true in the preview tab and the page stayed light. No dark set.
Pressed and disabled button colours: no disabled control was on a public page, and :active was not forced.
Checkbox, switch, select, textarea, toast, dialog, table, avatar, badge: not present on the captured public pages.
Sign-in form: /account/signin returned 200 and rendered the marketing footer shell with no inputs. The form was not reached. Account creation was not opened.

prefers-reduced-motion: zero authored rules matched that media query in the home stylesheets. The reduce verdict is a gap, not a measured honours/ignores result, because the probe was not re-run under emulation.
--color-amber-400 is oklch(82.8% .189 84.429). Left as a gap rather than converted.
LanderTall is declared (@font-face LanderTall-Book.woff2) and was unloaded on the home page. No measured element used it.
Product photography radius: the category-page product links measured 0px. A circular drink image was not isolated.
